text: The board approved funding, but that's a budget line, not a rollout plan. Scoping the next phase means naming which segment is next, what gets built in what order, and which dependencies can't be skipped.

Three horizons, applied to Hartwell: quick wins like extending MFA to the second segment's workstations now, foundational identity and segmentation work over the next several months, and long-haul work governing third-party vendor remote access.

One dependency this phase can't skip: the corrected, dual-check audit methodology from Lesson 19 has to apply to the new segment from day one — rolling it out with the old approach would mean paying for the same gap twice, on equipment with real physical stakes.

Scoping this honestly surfaces a hard scheduling fact: the foundational work can only be deployed safely during a planned maintenance outage, and Hartwell has only one scheduled soon. Next lesson, that fact becomes a real conflict.
